text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Hah...! How shameful of me, I am terribly 
sorry!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Actually, while monitoring the downtown 
live cam footage last night, I just 
couldn't bring myself to stop—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, I had patrolled the 
entire Kanto area, and dawn was 
breaking...!

Fenomeno worked so hard on maintaining 
public order that she didn't seem to get 
much rest...
